title: Persist conversations and scoped memory
description: Implement the selected storage policy with distinct user, project and conversation identities. Separate user-confirmed preferences, project facts, raw messages and generated summaries. Track source, time and correction history. Provide inspect, correct, forget and export operations. Store credentials outside conversational memory.
why: Memory must remain understandable, correctable and isolated.

acceptance.text: Two projects cannot retrieve each other’s private context by default
Correction replaces stale preferred facts in retrieval
Forget removes applicable source and derived memory
